text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, the property in question, ASSET-B, appears to be legally compliant regarding forests. The observations indicate that there is no forest cover on the property as of 2020, according to the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset. While there were tree-cover loss events before the 2020 baseline, the property did not have any significant tree cover at the end of the baseline period. Therefore, it seems the property is in compliance with forest-related regulations.
